title: Self-host Wold / Fen
description: Run your own hub on a server you control: what it actually takes, what it costs, and the three ways money can reach the project - with the affiliate disclosure written out in full.
lede: If the data should never leave a machine you control, the answer is to run the hub yourself. This page says what that takes - including the parts that are neither free nor one-click.
need: 1 vCPU and 1 GB of RAM carries a handful of people. x86_64 or arm64.
A domain, if others must reach it
Not needed when only your own machines talk to it, no matter how many of them there are.
Required the moment it answers to the internet. A free certificate is fine.
This is a server install. Budget an evening, not five minutes.
notTitle: What this page will not claim
not: **It is not free.** A rented server bills you every month whether you use it or not.
**It is not one click.** There is no hosted installer that hides the steps from you.
**We cannot run it for you.** Self-hosted means self-operated: we have no access, and we will not ask for any.
routes: People and agents outside mainland China
Users inside mainland China, where latency matters
Data stays in mainland China; reaching it from outside may be slower
The provider's own page at the moment you buy - we quote no number here, because they change
supportTitle: Three ways money reaches the project
supportLede: Running this costs us money every month. These are the three ways it comes back. **All three are disclosed, including what we get out of them.**

support.title: Rent your server through our link
support.body: If you were going to rent a VPS anyway, going through our referral link costs you nothing extra and pays us a commission.
support.pending: Referral link not open yet - so this is not a button. Nothing here pretends otherwise.

support.title: Mainland cloud, through our link
support.body: The same idea for a mainland cloud account, for when your users sit inside mainland China.
support.pending: Referral link not open yet - so this is not a button.

support.title: Just send money
support.body: No account, no tier, no perk. A donation buys nothing and changes nothing about how the software behaves.

disc: A link marked **referral** on this page is an affiliate link: if you sign up or buy through it, the provider pays us a commission. **The price you pay is the same either way** - going to the provider directly, without our link, costs exactly the same. A commission never decides what we recommend: the two routes above are listed because they are the two that work, not because one pays better. Where a link is not open yet, we say so instead of shipping a dead button.
freeTitle: If you would rather not pay anything
free: You do not have to self-host. The official hub is free to use within the trial allowance, and the client is MIT-licensed - you can also run it on a machine you already own, on your own network, with no rented server at all.
